From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Kapoor <sanjay.kapoor@medflow.com>, Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@medflow.com>
Cc: procurement@medflow.com
Date: Sun, 01 Jun 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + post-signature orchestration playlist — MedFlow go-live window

Hi Sanjay / Lisa,

Congrats again on the signature — really excited to get MedFlow onto Redwood. Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MedFlow_MAP_v1.xlsx) that embeds the post-signature work we discussed: rollout cadence, canary approach, migration steps, and the training program. High-level asks below so we can align the close->go-live timeline this week.

Quick asks (please reply with dates/owners):
- Confirm target pilot (canary) cohort start: we recommend week of Jun 30 — who owns the cohort list?
- Data migration window: preferred blackout windows for MedFlow ops (range or specific nights).
- Training tranche: prefer 2x 2-hour instructor-led sessions + recorded on-demand; who should attend?
- Point of contact for procurement & SOC evidence (we'll share the evidence packet).

Plan summary (attached):
- Week 0 (prep): final model selection, access provisioning, smoke tests.
- Week 1–2 (canary): 5% traffic slice, end-to-end observability, acceptance gates.
- Week 3 (migration): bulk data import, validation, failover rehearsals.
- Week 4 (ramp): staged ramp to 50–100% depending on acceptance metrics, training rollouts.

I'll follow up with a checklist PDF and a training deck for scheduling. If you'd like a brief sync this week to lock dates, I'm available Wed/Thu morning PT.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0126

Date: Mon, 02 Jun 2025 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + post-signature orchestration playlist — MedFlow go-live window

Vanessa — thanks and congrats to your team as well. A few quick clarifying Qs so we can sign off internally:

1) Canary cohort sizing — you suggested 5% traffic. Is that 5% of active users or 5% of requests? We want to ensure representative workloads.
2) Migration approach — will Redwood run the bulk import or do we coordinate via secure S3/FTPS? We need an exact list of required artifacts.
3) Observability / audit logs — can you confirm retention of request logs for 90 days and an SLA for access if we need them for audits?

Procurement also asked for a single-page timeline we can include in their packet. Can Lisa (cc'd) pull that into procurement's packet?

Thanks — Sanjay
Head of Integrations, MedFlow Health

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Kapoor <sanjay.kapoor@medflow.com>, Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@medflow.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@medflow.com
Date: Tue, 03 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + post-signature orchestration playlist — MedFlow go-live window

Thanks, Sanjay — answers inline and next steps below. Forwarding your note to the infra & onboarding partners for capacity checks.

> On Mon, 02 Jun 2025 at 11:20 AM Sanjay Kapoor <sanjay.kapoor@medflow.com> wrote:
> 1) Canary cohort sizing — you suggested 5% traffic. Is that 5% of active users or 5% of requests?

Good question — we define the canary as 5% of requests (by token volume), but we prefer to select a representative user cohort where feasible. We'll work with your analytics team to map user segments to request share during the canary window.

> 2) Migration approach — will Redwood run the bulk import or do we coordinate via secure S3/FTPS?

We typically coordinate with your SREs for secure transfer via pre-signed S3 buckets. Redwood will provide the ingestion scripts and validation checklist; MedFlow runs the transfer under SRE supervision. If you prefer we can offer a managed import as a professional services add-on (estimate attached).

> 3) Observability / audit logs — can you confirm retention of request logs for 90 days and an SLA for access?

Yes — hosted plan includes 90-day request/trace retention by default. Access for audit purposes is typically provided as a scoped export within 48 hours; we can add an expedited 24-hour SLA as a contract addendum if needed.

Next steps / proposed firm dates (please confirm by EOD Thu):
- Jun 30 — Prep complete and access granted (Week 0).
- Jul 7–20 — Canary (2 weeks) using selected cohorts (5% request traffic).
- Jul 21–27 — Bulk migration and validation (one-week migration window).
- Jul 28–Aug 10 — Staged ramp and final training.

Attachments sent with this email: canary-checklist.pdf, training-curriculum.pptx (calendar draft). Also linking the deal page and DocuSign envelope for your records: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/7832 / https://www.docusign.com/recipient?envelopeId=5f4d2e

If that timeline works, Lisa — can you confirm procurement receives the one-pager and DocuSign links?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0126

Attachments: canary-checklist.pdf; training-curriculum.pptx
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 04 Jun 2025 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + post-signature orchestration playlist — MedFlow go-live window

Vanessa / Neha — quick internal note on capacity and rollback guardrails for the proposed window.

- Canary: We'll allocate a dedicated POD with headroom for 20% over expected canary token volume. That should keep latency consistent under load.
- KV cache priming: plan for a short warm-up run 2–4 hours before canary start (we'll coordinate a lightweight synthetic).
- Rollback: automated fallback to model-variant v1.2 with traffic-shift script; rollback rehearsal scheduled for Jul 9 (middle of canary) if MedFlow wants a dry-run.
- Migration throughput: bulk import via multipart S3; expect 6–8 hours per 500GB with our parallel loaders — we'll need exact dataset estimate to finalize.

I'll draft a short ops runbook snippet to drop into the MAP and the canary checklist. Neha — can you confirm security evidence packaging (SOC2 artifacts + network diagrams) and any additional uplift for the expedited audit SLA?

-Markus
Director, Platform Operations — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com

- Procurement will pull the one-pager into their packet and has the DocuSign link.

Appreciate the speedy follow-up. Please add the rollback rehearsal on Jul 9 to the calendar and share the ops runbook snippet when ready.

Best,
